purpose: Audit findings, not a replacement dispatch queue. Re-read current owners before mutation.

findings.title: Three descriptions of basic controls
findings.evidence: The root README says Space fires; the GDD's control section assigns Space to Massline; its onboarding teaches Space as brake. The inspected input bindings assign Space/F to tether. **Confirmed documentation contradiction.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Generate binding labels from action data. Rewrite the onboarding conceptually and verify it against the shipping scheme. [README] [GDD] [INPUT]

findings.title: Reverse versus brake
findings.evidence: The GDD's terminology includes reverse/brake. The current propulsion path uses braking to suppress manual forward/strafe force rather than providing ordinary assisted reverse thrust. **Confirmed semantic mismatch.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Name the actual action accurately; changing the action itself is a separate product decision. [GDD] [FLIGHT]

findings.title: Old catch-up limit
findings.evidence: Orientation says eight steps while the current simulation runner caps ordinary catch-up at four. **Confirmed stale architecture description.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Link the constant or generate this factual excerpt. Do not change the runtime back to match the prose. [ORIENTATION] [SIM]

findings.title: A shipped scheduler is still ordered as the next fix
findings.evidence: The performance operator calls table cadence the next major task; the campaign calls the relevant work already shipped, and the activity-tier scheduler exists. **Confirmed instruction conflict; full call-site coverage unverified.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Reconcile the work receipt and inspect remaining consumers. Do not rebuild the scheduler. [PERFORDER] [PERFCAMPAIGN] [SCHEDULER]

findings.title: Historical zero craft damage
findings.evidence: An older alignment audit identifies a zero craft-damage multiplier. The current impulse kernel has a nonzero multiplier. **Obsolete diagnosis.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Test present damage/feel; do not repeat the zero-to-nonzero patch. [ALIGNMENT] [IMPULSE]

findings.title: Historical forward-held overspeed braking
findings.evidence: Older defects describe a governor that destroys earned speed. The current governor has a zero brake floor in that path. **Old remedy already represented in code.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Test release, boost, contact, and assistance interactions at the current base. [FEEL] [FLIGHT]

findings.title: Historical bungee diagnosis
findings.evidence: The feel document includes a fixed-stiffness stretch analysis. The current physics owner already scales stiffness with load and has a five-percent stretch target. **Analysis must be updated.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Investigate stability-bound cases and live tracking error, not the already-replaced constant alone. [FEEL] [PHYSICS]

findings.title: Historical rover rocket
findings.evidence: The playtest records a 0.06-second cell cadence. Current code has a tap/hold split, delayed cruise, and visible bore bite. **Fix present; subjective acceptance unverified.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Validate responsiveness and frame-rate behavior instead of merely slowing movement again. [ROVERCAMPAIGN] [DRILL] [DRILLUI]

findings.title: Positive questions inside an “any yes fails” checklist
findings.evidence: The central reviewer checklist mixes defect questions with questions asking whether the feature is reachable and the report contains evidence. **Literal polarity error.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Make every blocker predicate negative, or separate blockers from required proofs. [BUILD]

findings.title: A negative question inside a yes-count pass rubric
findings.evidence: The fun rubric includes a question about a bad visual stand-in alongside positive questions, then counts affirmative answers toward passing. **Literal scoring ambiguity.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Replace the summed score with explicit blockers and dimensioned judgments. [FUN]

findings.title: Two consequences for every action
findings.evidence: The build map and fun loop require multiple further effects from a new action. **Overgeneralized design proxy.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Require the promised causal consequence and meaningful integration. Do not require noisy secondary events for a brake, confirmation, or selection. [BUILD] [FUN]

findings.title: Every measured bar must improve
findings.evidence: The fun loop's strict reading rejects tradeoffs even when one improvement intentionally spends another resource. **Optimization-policy risk.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Protect hard constraints; compare the intended improvement and its declared tradeoff. Not all design metrics are monotone. [FUN]

findings.title: No quiet interval longer than a small fixed window
findings.evidence: A constant spectacle cadence can satisfy the instrument while destroying contrast and exploration. **Hypothesis promoted to law.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Use pacing envelopes appropriate to combat, travel, docking, and industry. [FUN]

findings.title: Any drawn path must preserve a fixed fraction of cruise speed
findings.evidence: Arbitrarily short or sharply curved strokes cannot meet a universal high-speed promise under finite acceleration. **Feasibility error in an unrestricted reading.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Define admissible path geometry and a force-feasible speed envelope. [FEEL]

findings.title: Rigid camera expansion and minimum hull size
findings.evidence: Several independent camera ratios can be incompatible in a dense scene. **Constraint conflict requiring geometric reconciliation.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Prioritize time-to-threat, target legibility, and a bounded zoom envelope; use cues when all three cannot fit. [FEEL]

findings.title: Hidden passive cap versus increasing industrial income
findings.evidence: Automation and site export share an overflow haircut; the mining design calls for successively higher industrial income slopes. **Confirmed design tension.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Balance physical throughput and demand, migrate the payout model, and show limiting causes. [AUTO] [SITES] [ROVERLAW]

findings.title: Attention cost as destruction
findings.evidence: A programmed drone group is removed when routine fuel reaches zero. **Confirmed behavior; proposed design reversal.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Default to visibly stranded or inactive equipment. Reserve destruction for an advertised destructive cause. [AUTO]

findings.title: Player cargo doubles as programmed-drone inventory
findings.evidence: The mining and selling path operates on the player's hold, including all units of the selected ore at sale. **Confirmed ownership coupling.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Give the operation explicit cargo custody and a canonical transfer transaction. [AUTO]

findings.title: “Permanent” excavation has multiple meanings
findings.evidence: Unanchored drill geometry can recover, while site-associated geometry bypasses that recovery. A Core is required for durable site identity across rematerialization. **Confirmed distinction, often erased by prose.**
findings.proposed_disposition: State permanence by lifecycle state. Do not claim that current anchored factories simply heal shut. [DRILL] [SITES]

findings.title: No fog versus a surviving claim-survey path
findings.evidence: The art/design law removes material fog; the site system still advances a volatile claim-survey record. **Potentially distinct mechanics, not yet a proven runtime contradiction.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Trace exactly which information each exposes. Retire redundant gating, or name assay/claim information separately from visible geology. [ROVERLAW] [SITES]

findings.title: Fifteen words and exact hex values as design authority
findings.evidence: The rover law treats word count, pixel values, and literal palettes as binding. **Useful anti-clutter intent, brittle acceptance implementation.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Preserve board dominance and warm instrument character; permit localization, remapping, scaling, and necessary warnings. [ROVERLAW]

findings.title: Physically plausible lamps versus current expressive art direction
findings.evidence: Older rover rules forbid many emissive accents; the current request explicitly wants more glowy arcade expression. **Current owner direction requires revision.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Preserve full 3D objects and material depth; revise energy-effect and light-language rules. [ROVERLAW]

findings.title: One thruster reference becomes an all-effects construction law
findings.evidence: The VFX standard universally favors geometric sheets, view-dependent edges, and simulation-authored detail. **Technique overreach.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Specify different techniques for jets, histories, impacts, gas, debris, and UI cues. Judge the gameplay-camera result. [VFXLAW]

findings.title: Whole-zone manufacturing paperwork competes with play-scale art
findings.evidence: The asset standard's camera-first and independent-review rules are good; mandatory material narratives can overdirect stylization and consume production effort. **Production-policy risk.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Keep proportional provenance and surface intent, not proof by paperwork volume. [ASSETLAW]

findings.title: Legacy golden success treated as production proof
findings.evidence: The legacy47a profile intentionally disables many modern features and uses a curated system set. **Confirmed test-scope difference.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Label every result by profile. Keep legacy compatibility tests, but require production-path behavior tests. [PROFILES]

findings.title: “Never fail a mission”
findings.evidence: The world-reaction packet requires mutation instead of failure for every clause break. **Overgeneralized narrative policy.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Author recovery where meaningful; allow clean failure, partial success, and abandonment without recursive busywork. [WORLDPLAN]

findings.title: Forecast must deliver at least thirty percent more profit
findings.evidence: The economy packet compares forecast-reading agents against nonreaders over a seeded hour. **Confounded acceptance proxy.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Test information quality, calibration, usability, and fair opportunity—not an arbitrary income uplift. [ECONPLAN]

findings.title: Input, audio, and performance too late in the phase table
findings.evidence: The build map groups several foundational response qualities with release work. **Sequencing risk.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Pull the minimal player-facing slices of those tasks into the first toy and Adventure proof. [BUILD]

findings.title: Ship scars versus a recorded rejection
findings.evidence: The historical alignment document records rejection of recognition/scar work; current ship code imports living-hull scar/history behavior. **Unresolved authorization provenance.**
findings.proposed_disposition: Find a later approval before extending it. Do not delete it based solely on the older note. [ALIGNMENT] [SHIPS]
